test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:free-license'
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect package metadata, runtime dependencies, and LICENSE

claim: Runs in this tab. No uploads.
where: landing facts, inspector, privacy, and README
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:local-processing'
sandbox: fresh browser context; edit demo data; capture the complete request log

claim: JSON types and provenance stay intact.
sandbox: typed fixture containing numbers, booleans, nulls, arrays, nested objects, and provenance

claim: Each page respects the row and byte caps you set.
sandbox: 12-row fixture; assert every serialized page against both configured caps

claim: The same input and options produce the same cursor.
sandbox: clone the same fixture; compare cursors; reject the cursor after changing the rows

claim: Chunks arrive as manifest, summary, schema, then bounded pages.
sandbox: 12-row fixture with five rows per page; collect the async iterator

claim: The package makes no network requests.
sandbox: spy on global fetch while packing and resolving a page

claim: The CLI demo writes a complete sample packet to a new temporary directory.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:cli-demo'
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; run the bundled demo and inspect its output file

claim: The demo reopens offline after its first visit.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:offline-reload'
sandbox: fresh browser context; open demo online, wait for its service worker, then reload offline
